entries.reason: Split build topics into Webpack, Grunt and the two handmade bundlers.
entries.reasonZh: 构建专题拆分到 Webpack、Grunt 与两种手写打包器。

entries.reason: Keep declarative copy/clean tasks with an ISC license.
entries.reasonZh: 保留声明式复制与清理任务及 ISC 许可。

entries.reason: Keep every distinct Webpack topic on Webpack 5; use asset modules and current dev-server APIs.
entries.reasonZh: 所有不同 Webpack 专题保留，更新资源模块与开发服务器 API。

entries.reason: Preserve the procedural parse/graph/emit pipeline; fix traversal and cache.
entries.reasonZh: 保留过程式解析、依赖图、输出流程，修复遍历与缓存。

entries.reason: Preserve parser/compiler separation with recursive dependency resolution.
entries.reasonZh: 保留解析器与编译器分层，修复递归依赖解析。

entries.reason: Modern processAssets hook emits a file inventory.
entries.reasonZh: 用 processAssets 生命周期生成文件清单。

entries.reason: Unfinished hooks draft becomes the plugin lifecycle explanation.
entries.reasonZh: 未完成的 hooks 草稿并入插件生命周期说明。

entries.reason: Keep variables, mixins, guards and escaped values; preserve GPL-2.0.
entries.reasonZh: 保留变量、混入、条件与转义知识及 GPL-2.0。

entries.reason: Compile and precompile an escaped template from one input.
entries.reasonZh: 保留模板编译及预编译，明确输入转义边界。

entries.reason: Extract typed actions/reducers; retire duplicated CRA machinery.
entries.reasonZh: 提取类型化 actions/reducers，退役重复 CRA 底座。

entries.reason: Keep task sequencing; delegate compilation to supported TypeScript.
entries.reasonZh: 保留任务编排，用 TypeScript 原生编译器构建。

entries.reason: Keep typed class props and compare type checking with transpilation.
entries.reasonZh: 保留 class 组件类型，区分类型检查与转译。

entries.reason: Hello wrapper merges into a single Card/Button library with three packaging paths.
entries.reasonZh: Hello 外壳合入 Card/Button 小型组件库与三种打包对照。

entries.reason: Retain Card and its CSS; retire CRA scaffold.
entries.reasonZh: 提取 Card 与 CSS，退役 CRA 外壳。

entries.reason: Retain Button; consolidate its Storybook and Webpack scaffolds.
entries.reasonZh: 保留 Button，合并 Storybook 与 Webpack 底座。

entries.reason: Remove duplicate library/CRA and generated Storybook examples.
entries.reasonZh: 移除重复组件库、CRA 及自动生成的 Storybook 示例。

entries.reason: Preserve the classic architecture, add a matching modern scenario, extract handwritten mechanisms.
entries.reasonZh: 保留经典组织方式，增加同场景现代实现，提取手写机制。

entries.reason: Repair Todo editing, async import and routing on React 19 while keeping class/connect, Immutable and Saga.
entries.reasonZh: 在 React 19 上修复 Todo 编辑、异步导入与路由，保留 class/connect、Immutable、Saga。

entries.reason: Keep dated architecture notes; link to current implementation separately.
entries.reasonZh: 保存有日期的架构研究，另行链接当前实现。

entries.reason: Duplicated official CRA manual is replaced by the official migration source.
entries.reasonZh: 重复的官方 CRA 长文改为官方迁移说明链接。

entries.reason: Move typed routing concepts into the modern Todo app; consolidate generated Storybook scaffolds.
entries.reasonZh: 将类型化路由概念合入现代 Todo 应用，合并生成的 Storybook 外壳。

entries.reason: Async counter and route scaffolding is represented by the fuller classic Todo/Saga scenario.
entries.reasonZh: 异步计数与路由外壳合入完整的经典 Todo/Saga 场景。

entries.reason: Keep element/component/render separation; replace shared globals with instance-local updates.
entries.reasonZh: 保留元素、组件与渲染分层，用实例局部更新替代共享全局状态。

entries.reason: Keep context, class components and History API; fix stable listeners and unmount cleanup.
entries.reasonZh: 保留 Context、class 与 History API，修复监听引用与卸载清理。

entries.reason: Name the actual compose lesson; support zero functions and argument forwarding.
entries.reasonZh: 明确实际教学内容是 compose，补齐零函数与参数传递。

entries.reason: Keep Selection/Range insertion and highlight rebuilding with safe text nodes and cursor restoration.
entries.reasonZh: 保留 Selection/Range 插入与高亮重建，用文本节点恢复光标。

entries.reason: Preserve representative attributed Enzyme/TestUtils cases; active behavior tests use Testing Library and browsers.
entries.reasonZh: 保存有署名的 Enzyme/TestUtils 代表用例，当前行为测试使用 Testing Library 与浏览器。

entries.reason: Extract the controlled EditorState lesson into a standalone Draft/Lexical comparison.
entries.reasonZh: 把受控 EditorState 机制提取到独立的 Draft/Lexical 对照。

entries.reason: Extract the controlled EditorState lesson into a standalone Draft/Lexical comparison.
entries.reasonZh: 把受控 EditorState 机制提取到独立的 Draft/Lexical 对照。

entries.reason: Extract the controlled EditorState lesson into a standalone Draft/Lexical comparison.
entries.reasonZh: 把受控 EditorState 机制提取到独立的 Draft/Lexical 对照。

entries.reason: Keep JSONP and compare local Fetch/CORS/AbortController; retire the private endpoint.
entries.reasonZh: 保留 JSONP，对照本地 Fetch/CORS/AbortController，退役私有接口。

entries.reason: Fix registration and respondWith; scope and verify offline caching and cleanup.
entries.reasonZh: 修复注册和 respondWith，限定作用域并验证离线缓存与清理。

entries.reason: Separate HTTP basics from the complete Apollo/Prisma application.
entries.reasonZh: 拆分 HTTP 基础与完整 Apollo/Prisma 应用。

entries.reason: Keep schema/class resolvers/messages on graphql-http.
entries.reasonZh: 在 graphql-http 上保留 schema、class resolver 和消息练习。

entries.reason: Preserve feed/login/post/vote/subscriptions with supported APIs and fictional seed.
entries.reasonZh: 保留查询登录发布投票订阅，更新 API 并使用虚构 seed。

entries.reason: Withdrawn for privacy: a development database with user rows. The app now rebuilds its data from migrations and a fictional seed.
entries.reasonZh: 因隐私撤下：含用户记录的开发数据库。应用现在用迁移脚本和虚构的种子数据重建数据。

entries.reason: Keep Rust/browser ABI; retire CRA and generate the numeric module with Cargo.
entries.reasonZh: 保留 Rust/浏览器 ABI，退役 CRA，以 Cargo 生成整数模块。

entries.reason: Preserve the 2019 report, screenshots and original claims; current measurement is a separate lab.
entries.reasonZh: 保留 2019 年报告、截图和原结论，当前测量独立成实验。

entries.reason: Consolidate readable drawing, gesture and animation algorithms with self-authored assets.
entries.reasonZh: 整合可读的绘制、手势和动画算法，使用自制素材。

entries.reason: Large bundled TGL showcase lacks a useful readable implementation.
entries.reasonZh: 大体积 TGL 演示缺乏可读实现。

entries.reason: Withdrawn for privacy: contained personal information.
entries.reasonZh: 因隐私撤下：含个人信息。

entries.reason: Bootstrap/Unslider wrappers duplicate existing component behavior.
entries.reasonZh: Bootstrap/Unslider 包装重复已有行为。

entries.reason: Retire the duplicate course copy; keep one slot-geometry implementation.
entries.reasonZh: 退役重复课程副本，保留一份位置计算实现。

entries.reason: Keep touch thresholds and index bounds alongside pointer-based paging.
entries.reasonZh: 保留触摸阈值与索引边界，对照指针翻页。

entries.reason: Merge vertical index/translation behavior; retire jQuery, autoplay and unlicensed photos.
entries.reasonZh: 合并竖向索引／位移机制，退役 jQuery、自动播放和来源不明照片。

entries.reason: Retain flex steps with semantic current-step state.
entries.reasonZh: 保留弹性步骤条，补充当前步骤语义。

entries.reason: Replace the copied ornament with a small conic-gradient progress mechanism.
entries.reasonZh: 用简单 conic-gradient 进度机制替换复制的装饰圆形。

entries.reason: Keep angle-to-sector intent; retire duplicate jQuery plugins and images.
entries.reasonZh: 保留角度与扇区的对应意图，退役重复 jQuery 插件和图片。

entries.reason: Keep full-turn/remainder arithmetic with awaited native animation.
entries.reasonZh: 保留整圈／余角计算，用原生动画完成状态驱动交互。

entries.reason: The original digit matrix and particle idea remain visible.
entries.reasonZh: 保留原来的数字点阵和粒子思路。

entries.reason: The six image exercises share one small page: draw, scale, watermark, magnify, filter and generate colors.
entries.reasonZh: 六个图像练习合并成一个小页面：绘制、缩放、水印、放大镜、滤镜和程序化颜色。

entries.reason: Two blocks share the same offset and boundary calculation.
entries.reasonZh: 两个方块共用相同的起点偏移和边界计算。

entries.reason: Extract the Huamao vertical page mechanism and the handwritten horizontal slider into bounded three-page tracks.
entries.reasonZh: 将 Huamao 竖向翻页和手写横向滑屏提取成各三页的有限轨道。

entries.reason: Keep the rotation lesson as slot geometry: distance from the current card controls position, scale, opacity and z-index.
entries.reasonZh: 把旋转木马保留为位置计算：距当前卡片的距离决定位置、缩放、透明度和层级。

entries.reason: Retain rotation, scaling, stacking and transitions using six self-authored CSS landscapes.
entries.reasonZh: 用六张自制 CSS 风景保留旋转、缩放、层级和过渡。

entries.reason: Preserve suggestions and selection, replacing the expired Bing/Taobao endpoints and synchronous XHR with one local Fetch.
entries.reasonZh: 保留建议列表与选择交互，用一次本地 Fetch 替换失效的 Bing／淘宝接口和同步 XHR。

entries.reason: Compare a requestAnimationFrame easing calculation with a CSS width transition on the same navigation expansion.
entries.reasonZh: 同一个导航展开效果对照 requestAnimationFrame 缓动计算与 CSS 宽度过渡。

entries.reason: Retain the relationship between full turns, remainder angles and a selected sector.
entries.reasonZh: 保留整圈、余角和选中扇区之间的关系。

entries.reason: Retire the obsolete app/dependency shell; representative tests are separately retained.
entries.reasonZh: 退役旧应用和依赖外壳，代表性测试另行保留。

entries.reason: Preserve representative React 0.14/Enzyme tests with attribution; active behavior tests use Testing Library.
entries.reasonZh: 带署名保留 React 0.14/Enzyme 代表性测试，当前行为由 Testing Library 验证。

entries.reason: Generated application output is rebuilt, not source-controlled.
entries.reasonZh: 应用构建产物按需生成，不入库。

entries.reason: Remove redundant CRA build output after extracting the type lesson.
entries.reasonZh: 提取类型练习后移除重复 CRA 产物。
